title: Greystone Gazette: PressRoom Editorial System
description: A local newspaper's in-house editorial system is leaking unpublished drafts after its sole developer was made redundant. Players audit the PressRoom application, chain an IDOR through a missing server-side authorisation check and land on a blocklisted ping utility with command substitution still reachable.
learningObjectives: Recognise sequential integer IDs as an IDOR risk and enumerate owned resources across user boundaries
Distinguish client-side access checks from server-side authorisation by comparing browser behaviour with raw API calls
Understand how OS command injection survives naive blocklists that omit command substitution
Compose a multi-flag exploit chain where each flag feeds breadcrumbs into the next
Map vulnerabilities to OWASP A01:2021 and A03:2021
